title: PvP HUD
description: Client-side PvP HUD for Minecraft: FPS, ping, coordinates and clicks-per-second (CPS) in the top-left corner. All lines toggleable via config.
body:
## PvP HUD

A clean client-side HUD for Minecraft PvP, shown in the top-left corner:

- **FPS** — current frame rate
- **Ping** — latency to the current server
- **Coordinates** — XYZ position
- **CPS** — left / right clicks per second (sliding 1-second window)

Every line can be toggled in `config/pvphud.json` (generated on first launch).

## Install

Requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.21.4.

Drop the jar into `.minecraft/mods/`.

## Config

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hudEnabled` | true | Enable the HUD |
| `hudShowFps` | true | FPS line |
| `hudShowPing` | true | Ping line |
| `hudShowCoords` | true | Coordinates line |
| `hudShowCps` | true | CPS line |
| `hudShadow` | true | Text shadow |

title: Custom Crosshair
description: Customizable client-side crosshair for Minecraft PvP: 5 shapes, colors, size, presets — all editable in-game (default key: C).
body:
## Custom Crosshair

Replace the vanilla crosshair with a fully customizable one, straight from an in-game menu — no resource packs needed.

- **5 shapes**: cross, dot, x, circle, t
- **Color**: 8 presets + RGB sliders
- **Size / thickness / center gap** sliders
- **6 ready-made presets**: Classic Cross, Dot, X, Circle, T, Valorant
- **Live preview** in the settings screen

## Usage

Press **C** in-game (rebindable in Options → Controls) to open the settings screen. Every change applies instantly and saves to `config/custom-crosshair.json`.

## Install

Requires **Fabric Loader** and **Fabric API** for Minecraft 1.21.4.

Drop the jar into `.minecraft/mods/`.
